name: 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA]
desc:
Welcome to Cell 13. Your release date? Never.

Something strange happens after lights out. Prisoners are taken behind the STAFF ONLY door... and they don't come back the same. Escape before it's your turn.

🔒 Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends.
🥔 Work prison jobs, earn cash, and buy tools from OJ's Deals.
🥄 Hide your tools, move the toilet, and dig your way out.
🔦 Explore dark tunnels and uncover the prison's secrets.
👮 Stay ready for roll call, avoid guards and CCTV, and keep your suspicion low.

Act normal by day. Plan your escape by night.

Lobby music: The Long Dark by Scott Buckley (CC BY 4.0).

llm.loop: work prison jobs -> earn cash -> buy and hide tools -> dig tunnel by night -> avoid guards and suspicion -> escape within 13 days
llm.objectives: escape the prison before you are taken
llm.progression: tools, cash, days survived, tunnel depth
llm.instructions: play solo or with 3 friends; work jobs, hide tools, dig out, avoid guards and CCTV
unique: Shawshank-style dig-out with day timer and horror twist
